mapper.sql: r.id, r.order_id, o.order_no, r.user_id, u.real_name AS user_name, r.reason, r.status, l.line_name, start_station.station_name AS start_station_name, end_station.station_name AS end_station_name, t.travel_date, t.departure_time, o.total_amount, r.handled_by, handler.real_name AS handled_by_name, r.handled_at, r.handle_remark, r.created_at

FROM refund_requests r INNER JOIN ticket_orders o ON o.id = r.order_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id INNER JOIN tickets t ON t.id = o.ticket_id INNER JOIN metro_lines l ON l.id = t.line_id INNER JOIN stations start_station ON start_station.id = t.start_station_id INNER JOIN stations end_station ON end_station.id = t.end_station_id LEFT JOIN users handler ON handler.id = r.handled_by
